Reviews

Great quality!

"Very comfortable sock. I can tell the quality is much higher than other major brands. My only disappointment is that they seem to creep down my heel and I have to pull them up. I am active walking and golfing, and was hoping to avoid that buy investing in this brand. I'm a size 11 Mens, so believe I chose the correct size."

— Jayme A. (3/5)

Super Socks!

"I have worn Bombas for years so I knew what to expect. The six pack I received have exceeded my expectations. These socks stay in place no matter what the activity (running, walking,gym). Extremely comfortable! Nothing worse than ankle socks slipping down into your shoe. Lastly Bombas mission is top notch!"

— John M. (5/5)

Nice quality but poor sizing...

"I've ordered two different styles of Bombas and both ran VERY small. So much so that I simply can't wear them. I'm a size 9 to 10 depending on the brand of socks or shoes. I have ordered the "size 9 to 13" socks from Bombas twice now to the tune of around $200 and can't comfortably wear any of them. They're simply way too small. I can barely get them on my feet and once they're on, they're very uncomfortable. I wanted to like these but I'm sorry... it's just not a good fit. See what I did there? Lol."

— Jeffrey M. (5/5)

Wearing out quickly

"Purchased 3 pairs of the ankle socks. Look and feel are great. Unfortunately all 3 pairs are showing signs of wear after just 2 uses and washing. I don’t typically wear through socks quickly, so I am surprised considering the strength of the brand."

— James S. (4/5)

Excellent socks!

"While on the pricey side (with discount and shipping, about $75 for 6 pairs, they do donate an equal number), you get what you pay for. This is the first time I have gotten the light weight version, and they are exceptional for the heat of summer. I purchased the 'left and right' version as I have had a couple of pairs of those, I prefer them over the 'ambidextrous' version (I have also had several pairs of those and the are comfortable!). These socks provide a nice support, and breathe well. They are nice and thin, also, so don't be surprised if you can lace your shoes a bit tighter to get them comfortable. Overall, I recommend them and will continue to purchase them!"

— Jonathan E. (5/5)

A little thinner than I expected

"I like the socks but I was hoping they would be a little thicker for a bit more cushioning. They just feel thinner than I remember them. I have a few old pairs that feel the same but it’s been years of wear. I just thought brand new ones would be a little thicker so just a little disappointing. Still give them 4 stars!"

— Laura C. (4/5)

2nd purchase of these socks

"I bought these socks for my workouts and thought they were very comfortable. They wore extremely well for me. I’ve had the original set for 5 years. I ordered the 2nd set because I was down to my last 2 pairs of the original order. I think they work and look great as an everyday sock or a workout sock."

— Kevin D. (5/5)

New bombas for me!

"I love these socks. Simply put I wore my first set for two years until I splurged for some new ones. The socks are so soft and comfortable. I have tried many other more expensive sock from specialty stores, but this brand is my go to. They make my feet happy."

— Charlsey W. (5/5)

Super comfy, but why the left/right?

"These socks are super comfy, fit great, stay in place through heavy exercise. Overall, I’m happy with them, but I noticed this morning after I had taken the packaging off all of them, but there were markings for left and right. I bought 12 identical pair so I wouldn’t have to bother matching socks, so that was unexpected. I purposefully wore them on the wrong feet today and they feel fine, so I’m not sure as a casual athlete that I am missing out by not paying attention to which one is which. I just wish I had known that before I bought them, I might have bought a different style where they were symmetrical."

— Nancy A. (4/5)

Best Socks Ever!

"My husband loves his! Thinks they’re the most comfortable ones he’s ever worn. We bought these for our adult son as a birthday gift…know that may sound crazy but, given the price of Bombas, thought they would be a good birthday gift! He’s a big runner so hopefully he’ll recognize the value in them!"

— Susan G. (5/5)
